title: lathyrus nissolia var. puberulus
intro: Lathyrus nissolia var. puberulus, commonly known as the pubescent pea, is a variety of the Lathyrus nissolia plant, a perennial legume native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its ability to support digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus nissolia var. puberulus include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. However, it is essential to note that excessive consumption of the plant's seeds can be toxic, highlighting the need for proper dosing and preparation when using this plant for medicinal purposes.
